milestones.title: R78 — the honest-errors + queue round
milestones.summary: The owner’s four verbatim asks shipped together: the error chain robustified (RetryError unwrapped so classification reads the real status; a 403 region block no longer lies ‘authentication failed’; userMessage is the API’s REAL text — only a real rate limit ladders, every other failure shows the provider’s actual words on the live retry card too), the composer’s action group restructured into a never-wrapping bottom-right anchor (Continue/Send/Stop/queue-send can never render in a wrong position), the Settings → General retry config (three per-class auto-retry switches — a disabled class fails fast with the real text), and the message queue (send while the agent works — the message queues as an amber chip, auto-delivers after the current tool call with full context, continues the same stream at turn end, survives stops/crashes via the pre-flip). Verified: 2708 tests (agent-core 1742), the battery-r78 live battery 12/12 (real 429 ladder + a mock-provider request-body oracle), browser-verified on the real dev stack.

milestones.title: R79 — the orchestrator round
milestones.summary: The standing R73 deferral shipped — addressable, background, resumable sub-agent tasks (the last unshipped piece of the R71 sub-agent discipline): delegate_task gained task_id (the parent model’s own address, grammar-checked, duplicate-refused, capped at 10 outstanding background tasks), background:true (fire-and-forget with an immediate receipt while the child runs detached — it outlives the parent’s turn, streams to the Sub-agents panel, and its status rides the next turn’s system prompt as the per-turn BACKGROUND TASKS section that disappears once collected), and resume (waits while the task runs, returns the final report idempotently, retries a failed child from where it stopped; the delegation.collected event on the parent’s log is the one delivery marker). The owner sees the address as a mono task-id chip in the panel + the chat card; migration 0028 (sessions.delegate_task_id). Verified: 2741 tests (agent-core 1769 incl. 27 new), the battery-r79 live battery 10/10 with the request-body oracle proving the model SEES the reminder section and its disappearance after collection.

current.title: R94 — the field-report round
current.detail: The owner's v0.91.0 field report, shipped as v0.92.0. (A) THE UPDATE PATHS: the in-app updater's asset-URL allowlist fix (browser_download_url's github.com host was never accepted — every download died with 'body.url must be a GitHub release asset of this repository'), the PAT now optional (public repo — anonymous works), the launcher's divergence realignment (git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD after the public-migration history rewrite — the 'Not possible to fast-forward' dead end gone; public-repo warning gone; update failures never dead-end an existing build), and the installer's orphan-proof kill (the sidecar's kill-on-close Job Object + the NSIS preinstall hook killing under-$INSTDIR node.exe — the 'Error opening file for writing' class). (B) THE CHAT: stick-to-bottom auto-scroll (only while pinned; the Jump-to-latest pill) + the queued-message MID-TURN injection (AI SDK prepareStep's messages override — the model sees the note at the next tool-call boundary and the transcript shows it after the tool result). (C) PROVIDER RELIABILITY: malformed_response (the literal 'unknown object') joins the transient ladder + the ONE unknown-with-PROGRESS retry with a visible meta.retry card. (D) COMPUTER USE: the Windows window layer's whole failure chain traced to the dead U32 Add-Type compile — the csc-free UIAutomation fallback (list_apps/list_windows/frontmostPid) + addTypeError diagnostics + the new window_action tool (minimize/maximize/restore/focus/close by windowId|target:'foreground'|appRef) + the no-vision screenshot gate (browser included). (E) BROWSER: the evalJob self-heal (tiny per-action scripts + one-time install; unexpected payloads recovered-or-retried with the payload in the error), the wait action, and the sequence action (multi-stage steps in one call). (F) THE SETTINGS SURFACE: real button affordances for the model-row actions, the optimistic hide/show (scroll preserved), and Test scopes (all/failed/working). (G) THE PROMPTS: the CAPABILITIES section (no-vision sessions told once, never screenshot) + the RECOVERY PROTOCOL (re-observe, ≤2 identical retries then change strategy, never abandon). Full pipeline green + the new LINUX LIVE-FIRE harness (scripts/r94-live-fire.mjs) proving the queue injection, the unknown-object recovery, and the headless browser/window paths end-to-end on the wire.

principles: Additive architecture — no pillar ever forces a rewrite
Quality over speed — every round verified before push
